Answer: B
Reason: Although the automated tools report a normal chest, visual inspection of Figure 1 reveals subtle lucent streaks outlining the mediastinal contours and subcutaneous emphysema in the supraclavicular/neck regions (guided by t000002), which are the hallmark radiographic signs of primary spontaneous pneumomediastinum described in option B. The absence of parenchymal lung disease or pleural effusion further supports this diagnosis over the other options.
